They were led by fifth-year (eighth overall with DePaul) head coach [[Dave Leitao]] and played their home games at [[Wintrust Arena]] in [[Chicago]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. The Demons finished the season 16–16, 3–15 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2019–20 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the first round of the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401210944|title=DePaul vs. Xavier - Game Recap - March 11, 2020 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2020-04-13}} before the remaining tournament was canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/2020/03/12/big-east-tournament-canceled-halftime-game-coronavirus|title=Big East Cancels Tournament Over Coronavirus|last=West|first=Jenna|website=Sports Illustrated|language=en-us|access-date=2020-04-13}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|Blue Demons]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 19–17, 7–11 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a three-way tie for last place. As the No. 10 seed in the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2018–19 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]]. They received a bid to the [[2019 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2018–19 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Central Michigan]], [[2018–19 Longwood Lancers men's basketball team|Longwood]], and [[2018–19 Coastal Carolina Chanticleers men's basketball team|Coastal Carolina]] to advance to the championship series against [[2018–19 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]]. There, in a best-of-three series, they lost to South Florida two games to one.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401125414|title=DePaul vs. South Florida - Game Recap - April 1, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-11}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401125415|title=South Florida vs. DePaul - Game Recap - April 3, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-11}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401125416|title=South Florida vs. DePaul - Game Recap - April 5, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-11}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
